text:
Eli: spontaneous 'raid + couch potluck' tonight in the mezz? small raid group (2-3) then casual co-op. start ~7:30. whos keen? :crossed_swords:
Noor: im in for the raid if someone brings a headset. not into loud streams though. :headphones:
Pat: can bring Xbox + one controller. also vegetarian samosas if people want snacks. :samosa:
Gus: got a Switch and a spare USB-C cable. can host a Mario Party fallback if raid runs long.
Rae: i have spare headset + mic. can do raid voice comms. also down to bring folding chairs.
Eli: perfect. need 1 more DPS or we go duo. @Noor @Pat can you confirm roles?
Noor: i can play DPS (ranged).
Pat: ill go tank, happy to swap if needed.
Eli: ok sweet. vote: start 7:15, 7:30, or 8? react :one: 7:15, :two: 7:30, :three: 8pm
Noor: :two:
Pat: :two:
Gus: :three: (running errands)
Rae: :two: works for me.
Eli: consensus 7:30 then. calendar-bot: event created: "Mezz Raid + Couch Potluck" at 2024-09-10T19:30:00Z.
Pat: logistics: ill bring a surge protector and an extra HDMI cable. last time projector HDMI went AWOL.
Gus: note: office Wi-Fi blocks outbound streaming ports. if anyone wants clips set OBS to local record only.
Rae: adding a small house rule: no public streams or clips without consent from everyone in frame. keep it internal. :no_good:
Noor: agreed. also bring headphones if you want muted chat. couch seats 4.
Eli: lineup so far: Eli (healer/support), Noor (DPS), Pat (tank), Rae (caller). Gus on standby with fallback Switch. More walk-ins can rotate.
Pat: i'll tape a sticky to the mezz remote so it doesnt disappear. learned the lesson. :laughing:
Gus: bringing extra napkins and a small bin for wrappers. please compost if possible. :leafy_green:
Rae: anyone able to bring ethernet cable? Rocket League fallback likes wired.
Noor: i have a 15ft cat6. leaving it by the mezz table.
Eli: last ask: ppl ok with background music? low volume only.
Pat: yes low volume fine.
Gus: prefer no music during raid calls. can queue for later.
Eli: got it. see yall 7:30. tagging newcomers @Taylor @Sam if they want to pop by.
calendar-bot: reminder set 30 minutes before event.
Rae: see you! remember comfy socks. :socks:
